request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and narrative, acoustic guitar, pedal steel, fiddle, upright bass, soft drums, nostalgic and dramatic, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Joseph came to Egypt's land
Bought from Ishmaelites' hand
Potiphar put him in his house
Trust in every single course
The Lord was near and he prospered
Success in all that he did
His master saw the blessing
And gave him every thing

[Chorus]
How then could I do such a great evil
And sin against God
He withheld nothing from me
Except her wife's love

[Verse]
She saw him handsome and well built
Day by day she spoke
"Come to bed with me" she whispered
He refused the call
"My master trusts me fully
In this house I stand
No one is above me here
Except her in this land

[Chorus]
How then could I do such a great evil
And sin against God
He withheld nothing from me
Except her wife's love

[Bridge]
One day alone in the house
She caught his cloak tight
He left it in her hand
And ran into the night
She told the servants her story
Screamed at the top of her voice
Accused the Hebrew slave
Of breaking her choice

[Chorus]
How then could I do such a great evil
And sin against God
He withheld nothing from me
Except her wife's love

[Outro]
But the Lord was with him still
In prison's dark place
She showed him steadfast love
And favor in his face
